name: Noise
description: A fine static grain laid over a surface with CSS, still by default.

opacity.description: Strength of the grain, from 0 to 1.

size.description: Size of one grain tile in pixels.

animated.description: Shifts the grain slowly, about once a second. Off by default.

isStill.description: Stops the shift. Moving content should be stoppable.

requirements: Pure decoration: aria-hidden, never focusable, and pointer-events none so content on top stays usable
Still by default; the optional shift is about once a second, far below 3 changes a second
Drawn with CSS only, so it needs no JavaScript and is safe in server HTML
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), with isStill, and inside an rdm-still container
Nothing flashes more than 3 times a second (WCAG 2.3.1) and moving content can be stopped (WCAG 2.2.2)
Hidden in forced-colors (high contrast) mode so it never fights system colours
Keep text on top at 4.5:1 against the effect: use a low-contrast colour

use_when: Taking the flat look off a large gradient or surface
avoid_when: With a high opacity that dirties text
On top of photos or charts where precision matters
anti_patterns: Stacking grain over text that must be crisp
